title: [review] test_packet_coap.py: Missing test for BleSecurityLevel.NONE
description: Line 904: The BleSecurityLevel enum defines NONE=1 but no test verifies NONE is blocked from /diag/raw/* paths. NONE means 'no encryption - pairing not completed' which should block raw diagnostics per spec 17.5.4. Fix: Add test with security_level=BleSecurityLevel.NONE verifying LciSecurityError.
